Happy Friday… **Swin** here. We're in the closing days of the
_[extraordinarily](https://zeteo.com/p/19-ways-trump-and-republicans-
are)_[high-stakes](https://zeteo.com/p/19-ways-trump-and-republicans-are) 2026
midterms, and if **Donald Trump** and the Republican Party lose control of the
U.S. House and Senate in an electoral "[bloodbath](https://zeteo.com/p/whats-
behind-trumps-midterm-obsession)," they will [largely
have](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdM4C29D2wh/) [Trump and his illegal
war](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-disastrous-republican-convention) on Iran [to
thank](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0IAVaFPc-0).

So what does our genius president do next? He's busy preparing to make the
Iran war somehow even shittier and more painful for us all.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we'll get right into the self-proclaimed "peace
president's" renewed foray into [Forever War](https://zeteo.com/p/new-us-iran-
strikes-show-trump-has). Plus, Trump jumped into the storm over GOP Ohio
gubernatorial candidate **Vivek Ramaswamy 's** despicable attack ad against
Democrat **Amy Acton,** and guess what - the president didn't calm things
down. There was also news of a startling new book about **Jared Kushner**. And
we have an exclusive political cartoon from acclaimed _New Yorker_ cartoonist
Tom Toro. Let's dig in.

It's warmongering season in a very warmonger-y year at the White House. Or, as
one Trump adviser who deplores the **"[Fox News
retards](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-advisers-trash-fox-for-nearly)"** - their
'r' word, not ours - for helping drag this president into the war, puts it:
"**It 's moron time, again**."

President Trump's so-called "War Secretary" [Pete
Hegseth](https://zeteo.com/p/secretary-of-war-crimes-pete-hegseth) recently
[huddled](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/20/world/middleeast/hegseth-
netanyahu-trump-israel-election.html) with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin
Netanyahu, who started the Iran war with Trump in February. The _New York
Times_ [reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/21/us/politics/us-israel-
renewed-iran-strikes.html) that "**U.S. and Israeli militaries have developed
specific plans for renewed strikes against Iran after the American midterm
elections** ," and that "**targets would likely include Iran 's energy
infrastructure, nuclear facilities, and missile and drone arsenal**." U.S.
government officials with knowledge of the situation tell me preparations have
indeed ramped up significantly, and that the menus of possible targets once
again include civilian infrastructure.

Several senior officials I spoke to are (to put it mildly) _massively_
skeptical that revving Trump's war machine back up will bring about the
(supposedly) intended result of forcing the Iranian government to make
significant concessions and end the war in Trump's favor. These officials also
fear a further cratering of the U.S. and global economies, which have already
suffered significantly during the oil crisis and other shockwaves caused by
Trump's war and Iran's shuttering of the Strait of Hormuz. (This is to say
nothing of the likelihood of a growing death toll in multiple nations, the
danger to U.S. troops, and other inevitabilities if Trump keeps at it.)

As far as many U.S. officials are concerned, Trump, Hegseth, and the rest
[lost the war long ago](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-doomed-from-start)
- the president just won't admit it. [So here we
are](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-no-way-out).

As for the blowback, _The_ _Guardian_
[noted](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/22/iran-threatens-seven-
gulf-countries-us-israel-renew-attacks) on Thursday: "**Iran will strike oil
facilities, undersea cables, datacentres and AI facilities across as many as
seven countries in the Gulf in the event of a fresh U.S.-Israeli attack,
Mohsen Rezaei, the secretary of Iran 's supreme national security council, has
said**."
